items.title: Onlend Unveils No-Code Infrastructure to Launch Custom Onchain Lending Apps
items.summary: Built by a team with experience scaling a leading DeFi lending protocol, Onlend aims to make it easier for fintechs, asset managers, curators, and asset issuers to build and operate their own lending products. Onlend has publicly unveiled its decentralised infrastructure platform designed to let anyone create, launch, and operate their own onchain lending applications without building the underlying technology from scratch. items.title: Bitcoin Midterm Election Pattern: Will BTC Repeat Its Post-Election Rally?
items.summary: Bitcoin gained 54% after the last three U.S. midterm election. Could the 2026 U.S. midterms spark another post-election rally?

items.title: Anchorpoint Plans Native HKDAP on Solana as Hong Kong Dollar Access Expands
items.summary: Anchorpoint and Solana Foundation are exploring native HKDAP issuance, while the stablecoin remains in an institutional beta on Ethereum.

items.title: Ethereum Whale Buys $63 Million in ETH: Smart Money Calling a Bottom?
items.summary: An Ethereum whale buys $63 million in ETH at $2,286 average. Is smart money accumulating as ETH searches for a market bottom?

items.title: Animoca Announces ADGM Fund-Management Permission for Institutional Expansion
items.summary: Animoca says its Abu Dhabi subsidiary has permission to manage collective investment funds, adding a new regulated route for institutional capital.

items.title: Binance Withdrawals Top FTX Levels in November, but Crypto Liquidity Defies Panic
items.summary: Binance withdrawals hit FTX levels in November, but $171B in assets, hack coverage and Bitcoin's resilience point to a stronger crypto market.

items.title: Bitbase Launches Bitbase 2.0, Moving from Trading Platform to Value Platform
items.summary: The upgrade opens with a new brand identity and mascot, BENIE, and will extend to the product experience and user engagement in the stages that follow. WE FOCUS.” The exchange’s new logo and visual identity are now live across the Bitbase app, website and official social channels, together with BENIE, its new mascot. items.title: Hong Kong Advances EnsembleTX to 24/7 Settlement and Plans Stablecoin Trials
items.summary: HKMA says EnsembleTX now supports round-the-clock real-value transactions, with regulated stablecoins next in its tokenization trials.

items.title: Kraken Prop Adds Commodity Signals With Lower Non-Crypto Commissions
items.summary: Kraken Prop has added six commodity markets and reduced non-crypto commissions on most plans. Participants submit simulated trade signals; they do not own the underlying commodity positions.

items.title: Noble USDC Holders Face New Migration Phase as CCTP Limits Start Winding Down
items.summary: Circle’s published schedule begins reducing legacy CCTP burn limits from October 31. Noble has a separate January 2027 pause, so holders and integrators need to distinguish the deadlines.

items.title: Bitcoin White Paper Turns 18 With Payment Verification Still at Its Core
items.summary: Satoshi Nakamoto introduced the Bitcoin paper on October 31, 2008. Eighteen years later, its central contribution remains a way to verify payment history without a central transaction ledger.

items.title: One Paper, Infinite Markets: MEXC Marks 18 Years of the Bitcoin Whitepaper by Looking Beyond Bitcoin
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 2, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, launched its Bitcoin Whitepaper Day 2026 campaign under the theme “One Paper. Infinite Markets.” to mark the 18th anniversary of the Bitcoin whitepaper. Since its publication in 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper has had an impact far beyond Bitcoin itself, reflecting broader shifts in how value moves, when markets operate, who can participate, and how assets are issued, held, and traded.
